canonical_spec.title: Strategic and dynamic asset allocation
canonical_spec.outcome: Design allocation policies across horizons and investor constraints.

assignments.scope: Strategic and dynamic allocation: explicit investor objective, horizons, liquid wealth and future liabilities/income. Derive liability and human-capital hedge demand with feasible constraints, finite-tree Bellman allocation and genuinely state-contingent hedging demand, dollar self-financing rebalancing with costs, strategic versus tactical information discipline and estimation-risk sensitivity. Original synthetic models, every objective and cash-flow convention stated, full solutions and portable lab. Do not infer lower long-horizon risk solely from annualized variance or prescribe universal age rules.

canonical_spec.title: Alternative assets and illiquidity
canonical_spec.outcome: Compare nontraditional investments with transparent valuation and liquidity assumptions.

assignments.scope: Compare real estate, private equity/debt, commodity exposure and hedge-fund mandates by cash-flow/claim/financing structure. Derive original transparent valuation and leverage cases, investor versus fund cash timing/fees, appraisal-smoothing variance/covariance distortion and unsmoothing assumptions, and lockup/capital-call/liquidity stress. Include determinate private cash comparisons (IRR domains and benchmark-relative value as appropriate), commodity collateral/roll accounting and strategy-specific hedge-fund costs/risks. No universal alternative premium, fake current performance or undated regulatory facts. Four substantial worked cases, eight complete exercises, explicit assumptions/boundaries and an offline lab.

canonical_spec.title: Execution, trading costs and market microstructure
canonical_spec.outcome: Evaluate execution and liquidity effects on feasible investment strategies.

assignments.scope: Teach quoted/effective/realized spread definitions with exact sign/timestamp/unit conventions, original information/adverse-selection mechanism, market/limit order execution and nonexecution risk, implementation shortfall with delay/fill/opportunity/fee components, endogenous impact/cost/risk tradeoffs and capacity constraints. Fully derive any model used; market mechanics in a stipulated venue contract rather than unsupported universal rules. Original reproducible dated order/fill/cash and finite optimization cases, four worked examples, eight fully solved transfers, strict information timing and benchmark limits.

canonical_spec.title: Investment policy and portfolio integration
canonical_spec.outcome: Defend a mandate and portfolio using economic objectives and robust evidence.

assignments.scope: Integrate investments into a complete original investment policy and committee decision case: investor liabilities/objectives, investable menu, ex-ante strategic benchmark, cash liquidity, covariance/active risk budget, financing and actual cost rules, coherent stresses and loss/shortfall, delegation/escalation/rebalancing/reporting. Derive and solve a reproducible constrained portfolio decision with feasible alternatives and complete cash/risk/benchmark reconciliations; distinguish chosen policy judgment from mathematical implication and sample evidence. Include a filled IPS and reporting example, four worked cases and eight fully solved exercises with explicit rubrics. This chapter prepares but does not substitute for the separate full Volume 9 assessment package.
